title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer thresholds and regional failover backoff (urgent)
author: Priya Patel
description: Urgent hotfix to stabilize the SLO enforcer during a regional failover spike and avoid aggressive load-shedding throttles that caused downstream timeouts. Motivation: during a recent cross-region outage customers observed cascading request rejections when regional circuit breakers opened and our backoff/hysteresis logic immediately ramped up shedding aggressively. This PR tightens threshold calculation, extends hysteresis windows for backoff escalation, and guarantees a short emergency grace period for queued requests during failover to prevent mass aborts. Changes include: adjusted SLO error-rate smoothing to use an exponential decay with a 30s half-life (was 10s), increased per-region CB cool-down from 15s to 45s, added jittered backoff to avoid synchronized retries, and added a short-lived 'failover_grace' flag that pauses hard shedding for in-flight sessions during an active regional migration. Includes end-to-end test harness updates and a new integration test that simulates region A->B failover with 2x QPS spike. Checklist: - Reproduced regression locally and in perf-canary - Added unit and integration tests - Ran load tests against perf-canary and observed reduced rejection burst - Noted metrics and dashboards to watch post-merge (slo_enforcer.errors, cb_state_transitions, regional_failover.rate). Linear: ENG-4021 documents incident timeline and rollback criteria. Merge notes: squash and fast-track to main, backported to release/2026-02 for emergency patching.
